source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed condensed interim financial statements 2Q2026 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (6 months to 30 June 2026 = year to date). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). CAR disclosure p.1-3, reviewed interim statements from p.4 (auditor PwC). Thousand Baht. SCI three months p.7, six months p.9. Revenue and expenses 22.1 (p.45, printed sideways; columns non-PAA / PAA / total, six months, both years): incurred claims and acquisition amortisation include PAA. CSM roll-forward 17.1.2 p.34 (printed sideways; ยอดสุทธิ ณ วันที่ 30 มิถุนายน พ.ศ. 2569); future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). New business 17.1.3 p.36: no total column; the onerous column is nil, so the non-onerous column is the total. Other revenue = อื่นๆ (22.1). RA release uses 22.1 (403,025), not the AOC RA (403,246). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the SCI for the three months to 30 June 2569 (p.7).
